purpose: Why the built-in voice of Drama 3 ran to the 1024-frame cap instead of stopping, and the fix: eos kept in every nucleus plus a serve-side default silence guard. Cause-level per-frame evidence and the before/after protocol arms.

engine.build: trim-bf16-int3 (14.50 GiB), Mac NVFP4 engine, scripts/build-engine.sh --weights nvfp4

protocol: smaller-builds: 24 texts, salts 0/1, built-in and eq-3ref voices, --max-frames 1024; failed = capped, WER > 0.2 or a quiet run >= 3 s inside speech (Whisper large-v3)

cause.summary: After sentence 1 of medium-05, token 251273 (candidate 3175) carries ~96.6 % of the candidate mass and eos is rank 1 at 2-22 %. eos cumulative probability then sits above both top_p cutoffs (0.9 request draw, 0.95 RAS redraw), so both truncated draws exclude eos: a stop the model asks for every frame cannot be drawn, and the take holds silence to the cap.
cause.passing_contrast: m04 s0, short-01 s0, long-01 s1 (all EOS-stopped): eos is never nucleus-excluded above 1.3 % before the stop; after the fix their token streams are prefix-identical and end 1, 43 and 1 frames earlier (the exemption lets eos win an end-game race it was truncated from).
cause.sentence2_unreachable: From frame ~250 the mass on resuming sentence 2 is under 0.5 %: medium-05 WER 0.68 is model quality, not stopping; no stop rule heals it without inventing speech.

fix: sample.metal draw_top keeps the eos candidate slot in both main-token draws (request top_p 0.9 and RAS top_p 0.95); kernels.zig forwards it, forward.zig passes shards.eosCandidate(e.c, e.w.n_cand); code heads pass -1.

drama_host fills an unset silence guard with floor -40 dBFS / 3.5 s: the same collapse trails sub-floor quiet or murmur around a late eos. 3.5 s clears the longest quiet stretch inside any passing take (2.06 s built-in, 1.43 s reference), so a trip never cuts speech the take goes on to speak; --silence-seconds 0 still disables it.
issue_32: The full-model tagged-dialogue cap of issue #32 shows the same signature (takes run to the cap while the model wants to stop): the same nucleus-exclusion mechanism under a silence-dominant distribution. The Metal fix ports to the CUDA sampler (one kept-rule term, one slot argument, one default); the full-model line needs the same exemption in its sampler.
limits: Built-in failed takes stay 4 of 48: medium-05 both salts and short-01 s0 speak only part of the text (WER 0.68 / 0.71), long-01 s1 stalls 3.1 s inside speech - a quiet-run failure; traces show no stop rule heals these without cutting speech.
The CUDA nvfp4 sampler (engine/nvfp4/patches) shares the mechanism but is not ported here: no CUDA window on this Mac. The same three changes apply.
